title: The IFPI says music companies and distributors agreed on new rules to combat the use of AI-generated music to defraud streaming services and divert royalties (Daniel Thomas/Financial Times)
summary: Daniel Thomas / Financial Times: The IFPI says music companies and distributors agreed on new rules to combat the use of AI-generated music to defraud streaming services and divert royalties — Scammers are flooding platforms with tracks then deploying bots to rack up plays and royalty payments
